title: tickingarea
description: Add, remove, or list ticking areas. See more information in the [Ticking Area documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/tickingareacommand).

from.title: from
from.description: A `vector` [x y z] that along with `to` of two opposite corners of a rectangular region to test for.

to.title: to
to.description: A `vector` [x y z] that along with `from` of two opposite corners of a rectangular region to test for.

name.title: name
name.description: An optional `string` to specify the name of a ticking area.

preload.title: preload
preload.description: A `Boolean` that queries the preload value. Default: `false`.

center.title: center
center.description: A `vector` [x y z] that specifies the center of a defined loaded area.

radius.title: radius
radius.description: An `integer` that specifies the area as the number of chunks loaded in. Between 0 and 4.

position.title: position
position.description: A `vector` [x y z] of a point within the ticking area.

all-dimensions.title: all-dimensions
all-dimensions.description: Specify `all-dimensions` to determine whether ticking areas in other dimensions are listed.
